pages.text: $(italic)A puppet master who commands from the shadows. Your servants fight, and their violence feeds your power.$()$(br2)HP Modifier: -10%  |  Equipment HP: $(bold)Halved$() (glass cannon)$(br)Mana Pool: $(item)1.9x base$() (190 from default 100)$(br)$(bold)Core Identity:$() Empowered minions and lifesteal.

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Dark Pact$(): your tamed animals and your Iron's Spells summons deal $(item)+15% damage$().$(br2)$(bold)Soul Tether$(): whenever something dies within 16 blocks, by any hand, you heal $(item)5% of its max health$() (up to 2 health) and gain $(item)1 XP$().$(br2)$(bold)Shadow Cloak$(): +10% melee damage in darkness (light level 9 or lower), and no penalty in light. Caves and night are your domain.

pages.title: Playstyle
pages.text: The class pairs best with Occultism summoning (T3) and Iron's Spells summon spells. Your own combat is weak, so your minions are your weapon, and Soul Tether keeps you alive.

pages.title: Playstyle, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Revenant$(): +20% attack damage in the dark on top of Shadow Cloak's +10%, and Resistance I at light level 4 or lower.$(br)$(thing)Demi-God$(): 40% more health (25.2 instead of 18), all of it kept: only gear health is halved.$(br)$(thing)Faefolk$(): +30% magic damage reaches your Iron's summons too, since their hits count as your spell.$(br2)$(bold)Next: learn Summon Vex from your starter scroll.$()
